QUOTE: `ClientPosts.createPost` in `app/client/rest/posts.ts:43` passes `noRetry: true`, and `app/client/rest/tracking.ts:383` maps that to `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`. So there is no transport-level retry either.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says posting opts out of retry (noRetry), but it never says that requests in general retry with exponential backoff and a limit of 3 set by the network manager.
